title: 開放ガードと深いボウル付きの業務用ミキサー
titleEn: Planetary food mixer with open guard and deep bowl
description: カフェやベーカリーの作業台に置く汎用ミキサーの静的プロップ。丸みのある台座と後部支柱、前方へ張り出す駆動部、内側まで厚みを持つ空のボウル、ボウル支持アーム、固定した平面ビーター、前右側が開いた部分ワイヤーガード、昇降レバー風の形状と操作部、背面点検パネルを造形しています。ボウル底と内壁は実際の空洞を囲み、食品や液体は含みません。ガード開口と固定された部品は外観表現であり、撹拌・昇降・電気機能、食品接触の適合性、機械安全を示すものではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.555 × 0.776 × 0.641 m、12,584三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A generic static mixer prop for a cafe or bakery work counter, with a rounded base and rear pedestal, overhanging drive head, empty thick-walled deep bowl, bowl-support cradle, fixed flat beater, partial wire guard open at the front right, lift-lever detail, controls and rear access panel. The bowl floor and inner wall surround a genuine cavity; no food or liquid is included. The guard opening and fixed parts are appearance cues only, with no mixing, lifting or electrical function, food-contact suitability or mechanical-safety claim. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.555 × 0.776 × 0.641 m; 12,584 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
